label: POST_HOC_LEARNED_RESTRAINT_INFORMATION_PROBE. All BabySlakh tracks are CONSUMED. Nothing here can be promoted. This does not select a model.
the_only_question: Can a tiny CAUSAL learned policy extract the weak reliability information that fixed deterministic gates could not, while leaving C3 as the harmonic-state representation?
what_this_is_not: NOT a learned colour state or a learned renderer
it predicts only whether C3 movement deserves influence

why_a_learned_model_is_warranted_here.the_evidence_that_licenses_it: J3P measured the pattern you would want to see BEFORE allowing learning. On synth_lead_pad, cross-view confidence at genuine harmonic events exceeds confidence at stable frames by +0.0233 - the largest correctly-signed separation of any family - against a within-stem interquartile spread of 0.0656. Signal is present; a one-dimensional fixed multiplier cannot separate it from nuisance.
why_a_learned_model_is_warranted_here.and_the_witness_is_not_meaningless: J3P improved four families of five and broke only synth
why_a_learned_model_is_warranted_here.what_the_head_is_asked_to_do: learn the conditional relationship between existing CAUSAL measurements and a policy distinction already known to exist - genuine harmonic change versus C3 moving while harmony is effectively stable. It is not asked to invent harmony.

CAUSAL_INPUTS_ONLY.principle: the product-feasibility hypothesis begins now. Only quantities already derivable causally from the existing 16 kHz / n_fft 2048 / hop 512 STFT path.

frozen_feature_vector.block: P0 current chroma state at t
P0 current chroma state at t-8

forbidden_inputs: any zero-phase or otherwise non-causal feature
CAUSAL_INPUTS_ONLY.standardisation: mean and standard deviation fitted on TRAINING TRACKS ONLY within each fold

SUPERVISION.source: the existing rectangular MIDI harmonic-movement oracle, unmodified
SUPERVISION.POSITIVE_KEEP: oracle movement within-track rank >= 0.95 - genuine strongest harmonic-change events
SUPERVISION.NEGATIVE_SUPPRESS: oracle movement rank <= 0.50 AND C3 movement rank >= 0.80 - frames where C3 is actively moving while the symbolic harmonic state is stable
SUPERVISION.AMBIGUOUS: everything else - EXCLUDED from the classifier loss, never silently labelled negative
SUPERVISION.what_this_makes_the_supervision_ask: when C3 wants to move, is this a genuine harmonic event or an unwanted response?

TRAINING.cross_validation: grouped 5-fold by TRACK. No stem from a held-out track may appear in that fold's training set.

recipe_frozen_before_any_score.class_weighting: equal TOTAL positive and negative class weight inside each training fold

TRAINING.defect_policy: if this exact recipe exposes an IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT, fix the defect and disclose it. Do NOT optimise the recipe against J3Q scores.

DATA_STATUS.corpus: all current BabySlakh tracks are CONSUMED
DATA_STATUS.label: POST_HOC_LEARNED_RESTRAINT_INFORMATION_PROBE
DATA_STATUS.only_meaningful_predictions: OUT OF FOLD. Every reported metric uses predictions from a model that did not train on that track.
DATA_STATUS.in_sample: may be inspected for debugging only and must NEVER enter a receipt result

MACHINERY_CONTROLS_NOT_PERFORMANCE_GATES: oracle labels are never present in the feature matrix
no future audio frame enters any feature
every reported scored frame has an OOF prediction
model output is finite and lies in [0,1]

CHANCE_FLOOR_STANDING_PRACTICE.method: unchanged from J3O and J3P - per stem, circular shift by a random offset in [200, 2000] hops, 20 permutations, seed 20260902

q_distributions_reported_at: oracle STABLE frames where C3 movement is high (the false-movement frames)
PRIMARY_SOLO_STEM_TEST.what_that_directly_tests: whether the learner extracted the signal J3P showed was present but weak

RECALL_GUARD.rule: event-tolerant recall may not fall more than 0.02 versus C3 on either primary family

PRIMARY_MECHANISTIC_REQUIREMENT.rule: for BOTH synth_lead_pad and reed_pipe the OOF learned gate must (1) reduce false movement versus C3 and (2) satisfy the 0.02 recall guard
PRIMARY_MECHANISTIC_REQUIREMENT.if_either_family_fails: STOP. Return LEARNED_RESTRAINT_FAIL. Do NOT run the visual test.
PRIMARY_MECHANISTIC_REQUIREMENT.reduce_means: strictly lower than C3's false movement in that family. An exact tie is not a reduction.

CONDITIONAL_MIXTURE_TEST.trigger: only if both primary families clear
CONDITIONAL_MIXTURE_TEST.strictly_out_of_fold: for every held-out track, apply THAT FOLD's model to the MIXTURE from the same held-out track
CONDITIONAL_MIXTURE_TEST.no_second_model: do NOT train a mixture-specific model
CONDITIONAL_MIXTURE_TEST.TREATMENT: C3 state + C3 movement x q_OOF
CONDITIONAL_MIXTURE_TEST.mixture_features_note: the mixture feature vector is built by the SAME frozen 53-feature causal extractor from the mixture STFT. No new transform.

requires_all_of: false movement decreases on BOTH primary families
the conditional OOF mixture visual test runs
all three visual restraint guards pass
LEARNED_RESTRAINT_SIGNAL.meaning: causal audio features contain learnable information that can improve WHEN C3 is allowed to drive harmonic visual motion
LEARNED_RESTRAINT_SIGNAL.what_it_authorises: EXACTLY ONE THING - FRESH_LEARNED_RESTRAINT_VALIDATION on unseen synthetic tracks with the exact frozen architecture and recipe
LEARNED_RESTRAINT_SIGNAL.what_it_does_NOT_do: IT DOES NOT SELECT THE MODEL. The corpus is consumed.

LEARNED_RESTRAINT_FAIL.triggered_by: either primary does not reduce false movement, or either primary violates the recall guard, or the visual restraint test fails
LEARNED_RESTRAINT_FAIL.meaning: this causal feature set and tiny policy head do not solve the residual

LEARNED_RESTRAINT_INCONCLUSIVE.triggered_by: control or training machinery failure ONLY

IMPORTANT_INTERPRETATION_A_POSITIVE_RESU: the need for a second frontend
it_would_establish_only: the policy/reliability problem contains learnable causal information beyond fixed hand-designed gates

STOP_CONDITIONS.if_SIGNAL: STOP. Do not tune. Do not enlarge the network. Do not train another model.
STOP_CONDITIONS.if_FAIL: STOP and return to the PM.

PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_AND_NOT_MUTATED.J3D: immutable challenge membership - FLAT_ENERGY 2299, NO_ONSET 4000, ACOUSTIC 3292
PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_AND_NOT_MUTATED.target: the rectangular MIDI duration-occupancy oracle, unmodified

DO_NOT_EXECUTE: any mutation of any historical receipt
